thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PAGER for tenant=\"silverfin\" (dedicated-reserved-pool). Reason: headroom_breach + latency_p95 spike. Impact: elevated 5xxs and >3x p95 on inference path. Priority: P1.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert triggered -> Escalation level 1. Assigned to arjun. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD-98765

arjun: acked. I'm on it.

sophia: I'm joining the call. pulling dashboards now — checking reserved-pool free_gpus and queue_depth.

mina: noticed autoscaler didn't kick for silverfin this morning; policy set to conservative headroom (min_headroom=2). Might be hit during burst.

arjun: silverfin AI requests: model=llama-13b-quant, queue spike at 10:23 UTC. Logs show burst of long-sequence requests from one client key.

arjun: quick checks: 
- reserved_pool/silverfin/free_gpus = 0
- tenant_queue_length = 128 (normal ~12)
- p95 latency now 3.9s (baseline 1.1s)
- 5xx rate 4.2% (baseline <0.2%)

sophia: looks like headroom hit -> queuing -> some requests hitting circuit-breaker and returning 503. Could also be KV cache thrash since sequences spiked.

kevin: Silverfin CS here — customer ops reported degraded UX at 10:20. They flagged a high-volume background job they started. Asking if we can give ETA.

arjun: ETA depends on whether we can add capacity or offload traffic. Options: 1) temporarily increase pool (fast) 2) route new requests to fallback model variant (llama-13b-int8) 3) apply per-tenant rate-limiter.

mina: I can expand the dedicated pool by attaching one spare node from the shared spare pool. Command ready. Need oncall approval and I'll run scale-up. This will take ~2-3 minutes to attach and warm caches.

arjun: do it. Also open a canary route to force-read fallback variant for non-critical requests. Sophia, can you patch routing?

sophia: on it. Patching policy: route requests with header x-client-job=background -> variant=llama-13b-int8. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: route-policy/silverfin/background-to-int8 v2 -> canary 10%

arjun: Mina, run the scale command.

mina: running: 
```
# attach spare node to reserved pool
infractl pools attach --pool=reserved-silverfin --node=spare-07 --wait
```

mina: attach started, waiting for kube scheduling and runtime warm.

incident-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback policy triggered for 12 requests; returned variant fallback=llama-13b-int8.

arjun: monitoring. p95 dropping to 2.1s. queue length 54 and trending down. 5xxs still 1.6%.

kevin: customer says UX improved a bit. They still see occasional timeouts. They're pausing their background job for now.

sophia: I see cache-miss rate high on KV store — warmup in progress after attach. Might explain residual 5xxs. Still, we're stable compared to peak.

mina: attach complete. new node registered and healthy. free_gpus now 2.

arjun: good. I'm going to increment canary to 40% for background requests to ease pressure on primary path. Sophia, keep an eye on error budget.

sophia: canary -> 40% done. No regression observed. p95 1.4s now on primary path for interactive traffic.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by arjun. Ack timestamp: 3301234700.

arjun: I'm going to leave the reserved pool expanded and keep routing rules in place for 10m, then revert if stable. Mina, open a rollback plan for quick detach.

mina: rollback ready: infractl pools detach --pool=reserved-silverfin --node=spare-07 --force-if-healthy. I'll wait 10m after stable.

kevin: I'll follow up with Silverfin CSM and give them a short postmortem and recommended mitigation (stagger background jobs, use burst-tier API).

sophia: creating incident doc in /incidents/dedicated/silverfin-headroom-3301234567.md with timeline and metrics.

arjun: moving to on-call handoff: evening shift comes on in 25m. @sophia please include current state and rollback plan in the bridge.

sophia: will do. Also adding notes: autoscaler policy review required (increase min_headroom for heavy-IO tenants).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation check in 5m. No further escalation required if ack persists.

arjun: marking: mitigated but monitoring. Leaving channel open for 30m.

kevin: thanks all. I'll loop in Silverfin with the update and ETA for full postmortem.

sophia: final checks: p95 stable at 1.2s, queue 8, 5xx ~0.1%. I'll set status -> resolved in 20m if unchanged.

arjun: resolving page from oncall side. Good job.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident auto-resolve scheduled if no new alerts in 20m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by arjun at 3301235610.

arjun: postmortem note: root cause = tenant burst job + conservative min_headroom; mitigation = added node, route fallback variant, review autoscaler. Action items: (1) increase min_headroom for top 10 heavy tenants (owner: mina), (2) add per-tenant burst protection template (owner: sres), (3) customer guidance doc for background jobs (owner: kevin).

sophia: assigning follow-ups in tracker. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
